notes: Label is approximate because the answer rests on text search, which the index says is always approximate. The search covers more datasets (meps, nhanes, nhis, nsduh, pulse, atus, pisa) than the index table lists; I included their hits. Excluded: diagnosis questions (gss depress, brfss ADDEPEV2/ADDEPEV3), general mental-health days (brfss MENTHLTH, gss mntlhlth), derived scores and episodes (meps PHQ242, nhis PHQCAT_A, nsduh AMDEYR/IRAMDEYR/YMDEYR), help-seeking, vignette, attitude and treatment items (gss down1/down2/down1a/down2a/hlpdown/talkedto/downqol etc., usepsyc3, prozslf3, viglabel), gss emoprobs (emotional problems in general), nhanes DPQ060 (feeling bad about yourself), and worthless items. Borderline inclusions: gss sadblue (personality item 'R is a person who feels sad and blue'), gss shakeblu (CES-D 'couldn't shake the blues'), nsduh DSTNGD30 (down/worthless/no good), yrbss qn26 (dichotomous recode of q26). nhis DEP_1 (2018) and DEPFREQ_A (2019-2024) are one lineage; the catalog record gives no table, so table is null. nsduh ADDPREV is spelled addprev in 2024.
